 International design platform brings together creative talent, industry partners and regional business networks, targeting 200 buyer–seller connections to foster business collaboration and cross-border opportunities. 
 BANGKOK, THAILAND – Media OutReach Newswire – 17 November 2026 – Bringing creativity and business closer together, THE WORLD ENDS: Bangkok International Design Expo 2026 will connect designers, creative businesses, industry professionals and international partners from across Asia and beyond from 25–29 November 2026. Organised by the Thailand Convention and Exhibition Bureau (TCEB), the event aims to create new opportunities for collaboration, business development and access to regional and international markets, while strengthening Bangkok's role as a meeting point for Asia's design and creative industries.
